title: RecruitClean: Candidate Data Sanitizer, Deduplicator & Scoring Engine
target_pain: Recruiting agencies and HR teams wasting hours manually cleaning messy candidate CSVs, fixing broken character encodings, removing duplicate applicants, and scoring resumes against target skills.
key_features: Invisible character & control code stripper (fixes '@' and unicode errors)
Smart duplicate detection (by Email, Phone, or Name with merge options)
Instant CSV/TSV/JSON parser with live interactive data table preview
One-click export to clean CSV or JSON
